items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Secures $1.5 Billion For Berobenatide Development
items.summary: Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) announced a partnership with Blackstone Life Sciences to co-fund late stage development of berobenatide, its GLP-1 obesity drug candidate. The arrangement provides up to $1.5b in development funding for berobenatide, focused on chronic weight management and obesity related conditions.
